definition: means any consultation or advice from a Medical Practitioner including the issuance of any prescription or follow-up prescription.
plain: Any consultation or advice from a registered practitioner, including a prescription or a repeat prescription.
whyItMatters: This is the quiet half of the pre-existing-disease test. A condition counts as pre-existing if you received medical advice for it in the look-back window — no diagnosis and no treatment required. A consultation about symptoms, or a repeat prescription you barely think about, is enough to make it declarable.
